findings.label: Continue's notice puts a resumed chat in Needs you
findings.detail: begin() now writes the Interrupted notice for a lease-free fenced Run in the 'Start a fresh invocation' change. ThreadRow.reasons are the chat's attention reasons and needs_you() is !reasons.is_empty(), so from the new Run's start to its result the row shows 'Run interrupted. Continue starts fresh.' and a chat whose killed Run left no candidate is in Needs you. threads-behavior.md line 34 says an interruption only enters Needs you when resuming requires an owner action. verification.md records the visible effect, but its proposed doc text covers only invariants.md.
findings.action: Add this to slice C's integration items as a behavior-doc question for the owner and the UI branch, next to the proposed invariants.md sentence.

findings.label: No test for a successful Continue after a kill
findings.detail: T6 used to run Continue in the killed chat to Completed and now runs it to Failed. By reading, finish() retires the begin-time notice on Completed (superseded includes Interrupted Runs of the chat), but a_later_run_replaces_the_notice_of_a_run_the_settings_change_cancelled starts from a Cancelled Run that begin() does not fence. The path this slice creates, a begin-time notice followed by success, has no test.
findings.action: Add a Completed leg to T6 that expects [Review(op)] after the new Run succeeds.

findings.label: Limitation overstates a kept lease file
findings.detail: verification.md says a Run whose process dies after the liveness check gets no notice 'and its file stays until orphan recovery or a later stop removes it'. That holds for begin(), which removes only its orphans. On the service paths remove_ended_leases calls remove_free for every Run the receipt ended, so the file is removed in the same call, without a notice.
findings.action: Reword the slice C limitation in round5/verification.md.

findings.label: configure and choose_backup_directory lease removal untested
findings.detail: Tests and guards exercise lease removal for choose_delegation (T1, T1-live) and, through the manual CLI check, pause. configure and choose_backup_directory have no lease-file assertion, and the two replay returns of import_full_scoped are unexercised. Dropping one remove_leases_ended_by call would leave the suite green.
findings.action: Loop T1 over the four settings wrappers, or accept the gap.

findings.label: Full record scan before each Stop, Archive and Steer
findings.detail: lease_free_working_runs calls Workspace::records(), which reads and parses every record body, notes included, before each Stop, Archive and Steer. Resume already pays this through recover_orphaned_runs. The core's queue checks find Working Runs with a json_extract filter.
findings.action: Filter Working Runs in SQL, or accept the cost.
